kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the two-phase flow diagram and the geriatric/slow-acetylator note; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis reading (the phase-flow axis: Lipophilic drugs → Phase I [Reduction, Oxidation, Hydrolysis, Methylation] → Slightly polar metabolite (active or inactive) + Reactive oxygen metabolites → Phase II [Glucuronidation, Acetylation, Sulfation] → Very polar hydrophilic metabolite (except acetylated metabolite) → Excretion [Serum (urine, sweat), bile (stool)]; and the polar-drug shortcut: Polar drugs (water-soluble) → Phase II directly, bypassing Phase I; with the modifiers: 'reactions do not have to take place sequentially (eg, phase I can follow phase II)', 'Geriatric patients lose phase I first', 'Slow acetylators have ↑ adverse effects from ↓ rate of metabolism (eg, isoniazid)') — KYP's synthesis of the page into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the flow diagram and the modifier sentences sequentially without a unified protocol; the framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (PHASE I = OXIDIZE/REDUCE/HYDROLYZE/METHYLATE (CYP450); PHASE II = CONJUGATE (GLUCURONIDE/SULFATE/ACETYLATE); GERIATRIC LOSES PHASE I FIRST; SLOW ACETYLATORS ACCUMULATE) — the page prints no margin mnemonic; all four codes are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints verbatim on book 230's Drug Metabolism section; all four codes are KYP-original.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on the page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for pdf 252). The Drug Metabolism section has ONE vector flow diagram (Lipophilic drugs → Phase I → Slightly polar metabolite → Phase II → Very polar hydrophilic metabolite → Excretion; Polar drugs → Phase II directly) — redrawn as ORIGINAL_KYP_REDRAW vector graphics in the registry visual (no photographs, no copyrighted artwork reproduced). The Phase I / Phase II reaction lists and the polar-vs-lipophilic input split are pure text and are carried verbatim in the note's table blocks. No copyrighted photographs exist on the page; nothing reproduced. No mnemonic prints on book 230's Drug Metabolism section; the four KYP mnemonics are original designs. NOTE: page 252 (book 230) ALSO contains the Elimination of Drugs section (zero-order vs first-order, with the PEA mnemonic); that section is reserved for a separate topic (elimination-of-drugs) and is NOT covered by this topic's evidence or visual.
